reviews.comment: There was nothing about technology for the first month. Talked about politics and expressed her liberal views in any way she could. Created debates in class that had no meaning for the class. Nice lady, but expressed her liberal views when not needed or when it was unnecessary.

If I could take her for every class I would. She is absolutely amazing. She really cares about each and every one of her students and her class is very easy to pass as long as you attend. She's super flexible with assignments, and she makes class fun and entertaining. My favorite professor so far, please take her if you can!!!
She was accessible outside of class and offered the most valuable and constructive feedback I've received from any English professor I've had so far.

Absolutely love this professor. She genuinely cares so much for her student and wants them to succeed. No matter your opinions she hears you out and respects you. I wish she taught my major so I could take more classes with her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is truly one of the best professors I have had at A&M! She is actually dedicated to making sure you are learning and understanding the course material. She is so passionate about everything she teaches and isn't only concerned with your grades. She is extremely receptive to feedback and questions. LOVE HER!!

Sweet lady but extremely disorganized. Whole semester was graded by like 3 things. You can never expect what homework, assignments, or tests will be and never updates syllabus. Class is extremely politicized and she makes it very uncomfortable to join in class discussions, which are mandatory. Pushes her liberal views constantly

She's so kind which was a relief for my first semester. She's slightly disorganized, but it won't negatively impact you. She gave very little work, so each grade has a bigger impact. She offers great advice and chances to make up your grade in office hours. Attendance mandatory, however she's understanding and cancels class often. I recommend!

She is so sweet and I can tell she cares about everyone in her class. As for teaching, it is evident that she is a smart lady, but the class structure is all over the place, she gets off topic and fades away from what her syllabus says. Shares her political view and wants people to share theirs causing certain students to take it too far.

I loved this class!! Dr. Mandell is so sweet and genuinely cares for her students. She is so understanding and willing to get to know each of her students. I learned a lot in this class and feel like I improved in my writing. I would take this class again!
So kind a great prof truly!
Laura Mandell is so kind and such an encouraging and enjoyable professor she makes me want to write. She has tons of good information and ideas overall 10/10 person and professor

I can't even say just how amazing Dr. Mandell, her lectures, and her excitement to teach were.  A truly valuable course to take at TAMU, it is one that ignites your love for learning. Our course was "Flipped", LOVED the flipped course design. TAMU needs more Professors like Dr. Mandell, her teaching makes learning worth it & more importantly, FUN!

Dr. Mandell is a great professor to take for ENGL 207. She is very passionate about her student's learning, but if you take her be ready to participate in the class discussions. She is very open about her liberal views but she is still fair when it comes to other viewpoints. This class should be an easy A for anyone who participates.

Honestly, until the final its so easy. The class is interesting and she is kind. The final has nothing to do with what we actually covered in class and you realize that all your notes do not correspond with the final review she makes. Also, its now 2 days from our final and we only have grades in from the first week.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was messy because she never did things by the syllabus and basically made up the curriculum of this class as we went. Interesting lectures that changed my way of thinking, but lack of clarity in assignments and the final made this class stressful. Everything was subjective to her opinion, making it difficult to study for tests.

Dr. Mandell is a wonderful professor full of knowledge. I took her 21st Century Human Thinking and Digital Culture course and it was incredibly easy. She was so kind, encouraged us to be independent thinkers, and was super understanding. 10/10 prof. The course was a little disorganized, but it was the first class ever so I understand!

Quizzes on reading each week but you can find most answers easily, 2 tests that p much count for everything, and supposed to be 3 papers. She messed up on grading for my class and only made us do one then let us pick one of the last 2 for extra credit. Cares about her students and will help you if you ask.
Online class was so easy. You can pass the quizzes each week by just watching her lecture usually, and she gave most of the midterm answers away in the study guide she made. Super easy class.

Online midterm and cumulative final, both multiple choice with some short answer on final. Weekly online quiz over reading/lectures: she gives most answers away in her lectures, no need to in read in depth. Take detailed lecture notes, I wrote almost everything down (they were only 5-10 min per week). Easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: One online quiz a week with 5 questions. We got lucky and got only one essay all semester. No tests, only a mid-term and final. All multiple choice, except final has a few short answers. Easy A!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Laura is so sweet and makes the class very clear and as easy as possible. You should keep up with your reading because she gives weekly quizzes. However, she is a hard grader when it comes to writing assignments.

Took online, quizzes and discussion boards every week but super easy. Most of the time she'll cancel the discussion board for various reasons. 2 exams, both very straightforward and either right in the text or in her notes. Very sweet!
